text:
alex: Quick PSA — Q1 weekly KPIs look weird after the launch. Dashboard shows a spike in MQLs but conversions aren't moving. https://app.redwood.com/dash/launch-q1
sana: saw that, looks like a UTM mismatch on the webinar CTA? :thinking:
jamal: can you paste the funnel numbers? don't trust the viz alone
alex: top-line: MQLs +43% WoW, SQLs +4%, opportunities flat. CTR on the launch post is normal. raw snippet:
```
week: MQLs|SQLs|Opps
WkN-1: 1200|120|30
WkN:   1725|125|31
```
lee: that ratio screams attribution inflation. maybe GA4 backfill or a broken campaign tag.
growth-bot: [auto] UTM parameter anomaly detected on /webinars/launch — campaign= (empty) — last change by marketing-ops at 1749100000
sana: @marketing-ops can you confirm the CTA tracking change yesterday? :eyes:
marketing-ops: yep — we shipped a tiny CTA copy + tracking tweak yesterday morning. i'll validate payloads now and pull a sample of recent leads
jamal: also check routing — sample shows a lot of new leads with source="organic" which feels off
alex: SDR routing probe: ~60% of the new MQLs from last 12h are labeled as 'organic' in the CRM export
lee: recommendation: pause any paid budget increase, run a 48h attribution scrub, and hold decisions until GA4 reprocessing completes
sana: i'll spin up an Amplitude segment for the cohort and share a link in ~20m
marketing-ops: uploading raw CSV now: https://uploads.redwood.com/tmp/launch-mql-1749123456.csv
alex: thx. can we do a quick 15m huddle at 10:30 to decide whether to pause the paid push?
jamal: i'll join and bring one-slide with delta numbers
growth-bot: [reminder] Weekly KPI review starts in 30m — channel: #marketing
lee: noted. tagging this thread for follow-up and an SOP update for attribution handling
alex: agreed. action items: (1) validate UTM payloads (marketing-ops) (2) re-run funnel segment (sana) (3) pause paid if mismatch persists (jamal/alex) (4) wait 24h if GA4 is reprocessing before final decisions
sana: taking (2)
marketing-ops: taking (1), running checks now (will post logs)
jamal: taking (3) — holding budget toggles until confirm
lee: i'll draft SOP edits for attribution edge-cases after the post-mortem
alex: cool — i'll post meeting notes and the updated dash link after recheck. :thumbsup:
